page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, prioritizing memory capacity over compute density.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It also does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory footprint provides predictable performance for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.m2.medium is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory relative to processing power. Suitable use cases include small to medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks that do not require local high-speed SSDs or GPU acceleration.
